selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 30 d voluntary wheel running (TRN) vs sedentary (SED) on heart gene expression in female HMDP mice, pooled across strains (S2.1.p1, S2.7.p1).
planned_contrasts: TRN vs SED in heart across all strains (S2.7.p1; per-tissue DEG count shown only in figures, not in text)
selected.paper_method: kallisto v0.45 counts -> DESeq2 v1.28.0, corrected using limma v3.44.1 for library prep batch and sequencing flow-cell lane (S4.4.1.p2)

factors.strain: HMDP inbred strain; mice of each strain randomized to SED or TRN (S2.1.p1)

selected.inclusion: female mice; GEO holds one SED and one TRN animal per strain per tissue (50 strains; the paper describes a 100-strain panel)
selected.paper_results: No per-tissue DEG counts in text. 'top 500 DEGs from each tissue (the average number of DEGs in a tissue)' (S2.9.p3); BAT has the most DEGs (S2.8.p1); liver and heart fewer DEGs than muscle and gWAT (S2.6.p1, S2.7.p1); Slc25a1, Acly, Ccn1 and Dusp1 DE in all tissues except liver (S2.9.p1).

decisions.reason: S2.1.p1: mice from each strain randomly divided into TRN or SED, 30 d in-cage wheel. S4.3.6.1.p1: quadriceps, gWAT, heart, BAT and liver sequenced. S4.4.1.p2: kallisto + DESeq2 with limma correction for library prep batch and flow-cell lane. S4.4.1.p3 and Figure 5A/6A legends: FDR < 0.05, no fold-change rule. Each tissue is a separate TRN vs SED comparison.

checks: S4.1.3.p1 and TAB1 name GSE230102 as 'RNAsequencing Exc HMDP, This paper'
GEO extract protocol matches S4.3.6.1.p1; data_processing names kallisto v0.45 / Ensembl v97 as in S4.4.1.p2
matrix GSE230102_heart.counts.txt.gz columns all end with _heart and equal GEO titles of this tissue

decisions.reason: The accession is the paper's own deposit for the ExcHMDP tissues; the per-tissue count file is used.

Matrix columns equal the GEO title (inspect alignment_keys). The first number of the title is the HMDP strain code (checked 1:1 with the strain characteristic across all 499 samples: 50 codes, 50 strains); recoded to S<n> so it is categorical. grp comes from the exercise-group characteristic.

GEO data_processing: counts and TPM obtained with kallisto v0.45. The .counts file is non-integer (~74% integer, median 1), i.e. kallisto estimated counts; the paper ran DESeq2 on these counts (S4.4.1.p2). Rounded before DESeq2.

The paper's DE estimand per tissue is TRN vs SED across strains (Figure 5A/6A legends: 'across all strains ... relative to sedentary'). Animals were randomized within strain, so strain is the matching unit (one SED and one TRN per strain).

covariates.name: strain
covariates.disposition: blocking term in the primary model (randomization unit; transcriptomes cluster by strain, S2.9.p3)

covariates.name: library prep batch
covariates.disposition: not in GEO metadata; the paper adjusted for it (S4.4.1.p2); cannot be reproduced

covariates.name: flow cell lane
covariates.disposition: not in GEO metadata; the paper adjusted for it (S4.4.1.p2); cannot be reproduced

decisions.reason: Each inbred strain contributes one SED and one TRN animal, so strain is a pairing/blocking unit; S2.9.p3 shows transcriptomes cluster by strain rather than group. The paper's batch and lane covariates are not deposited. The unblocked ~ grp model runs as a sensitivity analysis.

paper_route.method: DESeq2 + limma correction for library prep batch and flow-cell lane
paper_route.reason: library prep batch and flow-cell lane are not in the GEO metadata

deviations: strain added as blocking term in the primary model; unblocked ~ grp as sensitivity
kallisto estimated counts rounded to integers for DESeq2
GEO holds 50 strains, not the 100 described

decisions.reason: DESeq2 is the paper's method and the matrix supports it (estimated counts, rounded).
S4.4.1.p3 and Figure 5A/6A legends: significant at FDR < 0.05; no fold-change rule stated.
DESeq2 ~ strain + grp: TRN vs SED blocked on the randomization unit.
DESeq2 ~ grp: the paper's model minus the undeposited batch/lane terms.

caveats: The paper gives no per-tissue DEG count in the text (figures S11A/S12A only): only an average of ~500 DEGs per tissue, BAT the most, liver and heart fewer.
The paper's batch and flow-cell lane adjustment cannot be reproduced.
The GEO deposit has 50 strains x 1 animal per arm per tissue; the paper describes 100 strains.

decisions.reason: The paper's estimand and method are reproduced on the deposited data with declared deviations (no batch/lane, strain blocking).
